name: El Pinacate and Gran Desierto de Altar Biosphere Reserve
description: In Mexico's northwestern Sonoran Desert, just south of the Arizona border, this vast reserve pairs two landscapes. To the east, black and red lava flows and ten huge, nearly circular craters mark a dormant volcanic field. To the west, shifting star, dome and linear dunes rise up to 200 metres, with granite peaks standing out like islands in the sand and sheltering rare species like the Sonoran pronghorn.
